fields.cover_headline: Your daily distribution routine, in {o:4 moves}
fields.cover_sub: You shipped it fast. Find buyers faster.
fields.step1_body:
They ask for tools in public,
every day.
A launch only catches one
of those days.
A routine catches the rest.
Move 1 starts with
a free phrase list.
fields.step2_body:
Pick one: "any tool for..."
or "alternatives to..."
Add the problem your app solves.
Search it where your buyers post.
Then read what comes back.
fields.step3_body:
Skip anything old
or already answered.
Keep the posts where
someone still asks.
Those are today's buyers.
Next: say something useful.
fields.step4_body:
One good reply beats
ten rushed ones.
Help with the exact
problem they named.
Say you built a tool
if you mention it.
Then keep what they said.
fields.step5_body:
Copy the exact phrase
they used.
That's your next search.
And the opening line
of your next post.
Tomorrow, start again
at move 1.
fields.cta_headline: You built it. Now what, daily?
fields.cta_subtext: Comment SIGNALS and I'll DM you the Buyer Signal Phrase List: the phrases to search in move 1.
